mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand deterioration, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 100) indicates expanding manufacturing output and strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 650.0 thousand units signals residential sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates stagflationary risk that triggers equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100) in the industrial production cycle reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.
